summary: Review B of Phase S4 at b5c7fb0 passes with no blocking finding. The A11 recipe only reads two fixed documents and runs a quoted [ -e ] test. It has no eval, no write, and no command substitution of document text. Hostile backtick text did not run a command or create a file. The doc drift detector section adds no permission and gives no instruction to run document commands, edit files, or pass secrets. The S4 Red suite writes nothing in the repository.
security_applicability_reason: test-strategy.md Phase S4 line 253 says 'Review B (security): applicable, short scope.' The phase diff changes the A11 recipe in two catalogs, the audit role prose, and adds tests/spec_review_gate/test_s4_doc_drift.sh, which runs the recipe.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Nit] review-b: the A11 regex accepts a leading '..' component, so a document path such as '../../../../etc/passwd' makes the recipe test the existence of a file outside the repository. The probe confirmed this: the path gave no candidate line because the file exists. The recipe reads no file content and prints only characters from the regex class. test-strategy.md line 255 rates this as a Nit at most. No change is necessary.

N2 [Nit] review-b: the doc drift detector section lists 'a command' and 'a behavior' as claim types, and step 3 says 'Find the code that the claim names. Compare the claim with the code.' The section gives no instruction to run a command from a document, so this is not the Blocker of test-strategy.md line 256. The section also has no explicit statement that the audit checks a command claim by its definition in the code and does not run it. The audit role keeps a wide bash permission ('*': allow) from before this phase. A later track can add one sentence: 'Check a command claim by its definition in the code. Do not run commands that a document names.'

N3 [Nit] review-b: a backtick path that starts with '-' (for example '-rf/x', '--help/x', '-e/x') passes the regex. The recipe gives it only to the quoted test '[ -e "$p" ]' and to an echo string that starts with '$doc', so bash reads it as an operand, not as an option. The probe printed each one as a normal candidate line. No change is necessary.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD printed b5c7fb048541c342e800a53131e02e57b5b8d443, which equals audited_head_sha.

git diff --stat 4be31b2..b5c7fb0 shows 9 files: CHANGELOG.md, README.md, agents/measure-orchestrator-audit.md, agents/measure-strategy.md, measure/anti-patterns.md, the track plan.md, skills/measure-orchestrator/SKILL.md, skills/measure-orchestrator/references/anti-pattern-catalog.md, and tests/spec_review_gate/test_s4_doc_drift.sh.

The A11 recipe extracted from both catalogs is identical (probe 1: 'recipes identical: True'). It is three lines: a for loop over the fixed list 'measure/product.md measure/tech-stack.md', a pipeline grep -o | tr -d | grep -E | sort -u, and 'while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || echo ...; done'.

Static scan of the recipe (probe 1): no eval, no source, no '>' redirect, no '$(' and no backtick command substitution, no rm, mv, cp, tee, touch, or sed -i. The one 'unquoted $p' regex hit is a false match: '$p' occurs only inside the double-quoted echo string and the quoted [ -e "$p" ] test.

Probe 1 ran the recipe with plain bash in a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory on fixture documents with 20 hostile items (LF in product.md, CRLF in tech-stack.md): leading '-', '$(touch PWNED_SUB)/x', 'a/$(touch PWNED_SUB2)', a backtick-split 'touch PWNED_BT', 'tests/*.sh', 'a b/c', '../../../../etc/passwd', ';', '|', '&&', an ESC byte, a span across two lines, and CRLF. Exit 0, stderr empty, 'PWNED markers: none', 'folder unchanged: True'.

Probe 1 output: the regex dropped every item with '$', '(', '*', space, ';', '|', '&', ESC, or a line break. 'ESC byte in stdout: False CR byte in stdout: False'. A span cannot cross a line, because grep -o reads one line at a time. The CRLF document gave 'crlf/path' without a CR byte.
Probe 1 with 10,000 path claims: exit 0, 10007 output lines, 0.67 seconds, below the 5 second limit of test-strategy.md line 265.

agents/measure-orchestrator-audit.md: the phase diff has hunks only at line 55 (Inputs item 5 and 'A1–A11 today') and line 163 (the new '## Doc drift detector' section). The frontmatter (lines 1-25 and later permission lines) has no changed line; a grep for changed permission, bash, or edit lines in the diff counted 0.

The '## Doc drift detector' section tells the audit to run the A11 recipe from the repository root, list claims, find the code, compare, and add 'DRIFT:' lines to nonblocking_findings. It contains no instruction to run a command that a document names, no instruction to edit a file, and no mention of a secret, token, credential, or environment variable. 'options: update the document, or open a track' are options for the user in the finding text, and the A11 Fix line says 'The user picks one.'
